_comment_customerLayout: House pattern from FIR001/JAY000 (2026-09): customer SOA = v5 LPG ledger (Part 1A, plain English) + 3-row account position (LPG vs cylinder deposits). Chosen here because the prior IVE001_Customer_Ledger_Apr2026.md only ever showed LPG activity and its Amount due happened to equal the combined ERP balance because Part 1B netted to R0.00 at that point in time (2026-07-22) — that coincidence no longer holds (Part 1B now closes at R1,207.50), so the account position table is needed to avoid an LPG-only ledger implying a different balance than the ERP header.
